_meta.description: Luxembourg school holidays (vacances et congés scolaires), public education. Keyed by school year, which runs mid-September to mid-July. Every range is INCLUSIVE of both endpoints.
_meta.applies_to: Luxembourg public primary and secondary education. NOT international/European schools, NOT university (which has its own academic calendar).

structure_invariants.note: Verified across all years below. calendar_lux.py asserts these, so a future typo is caught rather than silently shipped.

_meta.warning: School holidays CANNOT be computed or extrapolated. They are set by grand-ducal regulation and the conventions change between regulations. Two proofs: (1) the 'congé de la Pentecôte' is NOT aligned with Pentecost - in 2023/2024 Whit Monday was 2024-05-20 while the Pentecost holiday was 2024-05-25..06-02, a different week; (2) the summer start rule changed between regulations - the 2022-2025 regulation used a fixed 15/16 July, the 2026-2029 regulation uses a Friday (16 Jul 2027, 14 Jul 2028, 13 Jul 2029). Always transcribe from the regulation.

sources.reg_2022_2025: Règlement grand-ducal fixing calendars for 2022/2023-2024/2025. Text: https://bourscheid.lu/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Calendrier-des-vacances-scolaires-2022-2025.pdf
sources.reg_2025_2028_fedil: FEDIL republication of the regulation covering 2025/2026: https://fedil.lu/en/publications/vacances-scolaires-2025-2028/
sources.reg_2026_2029: Règlement grand-ducal du 3 juin 2026 fixant les calendriers des vacances et congés scolaires pour les années scolaires 2026/2027, 2027/2028 et 2028/2029. Published at https://men.public.lu/fr/vacances-scolaires.html

2023/2024.notes: Whit Monday 2024-05-20 was a separate single day off, two weeks BEFORE the Pentecost school holiday. It is already covered as a public holiday. The notebook's approximation assumed the Pentecost holiday surrounded Whit Monday and was 14 days wrong - see legacy_notebook_ranges.

2025/2026.confidence: regulation republished by FEDIL - one step removed from MENJE; re-verify against the primary text when convenient

2027/2028.notes: St Nicholas 2027-12-06: ELEMENTARY schools only, so secondary traffic is unaffected. Excluded from IS_SCHOOL_HOLIDAY by default; see calendar_lux.include_single_days.

legacy_notebook_ranges._why: RECORD ONLY - not loaded by any code path. The APPROXIMATE ranges hardcoded in legacy notebook cell 84, kept so the errors found in them stay documented and auditable. calendar_lux.school_ranges() has no legacy mode and cannot select these; a test asserts that. The notebook's MAE 14.15 was produced with these dates and is therefore NOT a target to reproduce - see IMPROVEMENTS.md Section 9.

_errors_vs_official.pentecost_2024: notebook 2024-05-18..05-26 vs official 2024-05-25..06-02 -> 14 days mislabelled, INSIDE THE TRAINING DATA (~355,000 rows)
_errors_vs_official.all_saints_2025: notebook 2025-10-25..11-02 vs official 2025-11-01..11-09 -> 14 days mislabelled, corrupted the 2025 evaluation that produced MAE 14.06 (so 14.06 is slightly PESSIMISTIC)
_errors_vs_official.easter_2025: notebook ends 2025-04-21 vs official 2025-04-20 -> 1 day; 04-21 is Easter Monday so IS_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY covers it anyway
